rule: walk: key K from each entry's tag 29 (kind, flow_id, env, version), tag 27 stream_id and tenant; every entry of a chain has the same K and chain.seq = its position; the first batch has prev_checksum = genesis(K), every later batch the previous batch's checksum; from the chain's S-3 history boundary every entry is a Merkle batch (S-3): leaf = SHA-256(0x00 || "seam.audit.leaf.v1" || digest), the member folds its inclusion_path (tag 33) from leaf_index (tag 31) of leaf_count (tag 32) to the root by RFC 9162 §2.1.3.2 with node = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), entry digest = SHA-256("seam.audit.batch.v1" || root || u64be(leaf_count)), checksum = SHA-256(prev_checksum || entry digest); the members of one batch are consecutive, leaf_index 0..leaf_count, and share prev_checksum and checksum; a batch of one has index 0, count 1 and an empty path; a DECISION_SEALED digest recomputes as record digest v4; an AUDIT_ENTRY digest is an OPAQUE stand-in (SHA-256 of "chain-link-vector:<entry_id>", not the store's per-kind entry digest) and is only linked, never recomputed. Below the boundary an entry has the pre-S-3 shape: leaf_count 0 on the wire (tags 31-33 absent), checksum = SHA-256(prev_checksum || digest) over its own digest. The switch is one-way: a pre-S-3 entry after a batch is refused (pre_s3_at_or_above_boundary). Where a case states batch_boundary (the boundary a v3 CHAIN_MANIFEST or an evidence bundle signs; null = no batch yet), a batch below it is refused (batch_below_boundary) and a pre-S-3 entry at or above it is refused (pre_s3_at_or_above_boundary). JSON and pb decode to the same event.
